technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early reversal signals are offset by pervasive bearish structure, weak trend confirmation, and negative volume/momentum indicators—insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CTSH shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 48 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity with no composite signal; broad market fear (38/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of senior conviction and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (240+) indicates extreme market stress, FOMC event just concluded, and earnings in 48 days add event risk to IT sector exposure.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period), stochRSI bullish cross, and 15x volume spike create textbook reversal setup with price near support (52.60) in a fear-driven market offering contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, MACD negative, no trend, weak ADX, three black crows, negative CMF/OBV), zero fundamental/smart money support, earnings event risk in 48 days, inverted yield curve, and VIX crisis levels (240+) create overwhelming headwinds that overshadow isolated oversold technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) and stochRSI bullish cross with 15x volume spike create isolated reversal signals; however, pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, negative MACD, weak trend, three black crows) and zero fundamental/smart money support eliminate confluence required for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 48 days combined with inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (240+), and negative volume/momentum indicators create compounding event and macro risks that could extend downside despite technical oversold conditions.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias despite isolated oversold technicals
decision.portfolio_note: Already 9 positions in Information Technology sector; adding CTSH would increase sector concentration risk during macro stress and earnings season without offsetting conviction.
